validation_definition: Identity, modality, design relevance and public availability established from repository metadata and/or primary source. VALIDATED does not mean matrix QC, complete metadata, adequate power or ready for differential expression.
shared_sample_rule: Keep one GSM identity and all series memberships. Do not merge experiments just because they share a paper or BioProject; do not assume shared arrays are independent replication.
sample_metadata_scope: All GSMs in the four2017 hypobaria subseries and GSE308672; first two representative samples per additional GEO comparator/atlas. No biological measurement tables downloaded.

manual_exclusions.reason: Water-by-nitrogen accession multiomics too indirect for pressure/oxygen shortlist
Osmotic/salt root/shoot study, not oxygen/pressure; no need to inventory all stress studies
H2O2/LaCl3 leaf treatment, not atmospheric oxygen or pressure
Photorespiration mutants/fluctuating light; no direct atmospheric manipulation verified
Root cell-cycle reference largely redundant with prioritized root atlas; reused samples need deduplication

coverage_limitations: Exploratory targeted search, not a systematic review and not exhaustive absence evidence.

Initial PRIDE projects keyword endpoint was unfiltered. Corrected search/projects endpoint returned an empty list for two literal combined queries; manual accession discovery recovered relevant adjacent datasets.
MetaboLights API400, Expression Atlas unavailable, Zenodo API403; Workbench schema needs review. Public pages and OmicsDI supplement but do not establish exhaustive coverage.
OSDR file API is one-based. Initial page0 false-empty responses were replaced with successful page1 inventories for OSD-134/136.
GEO query translation broadened one title query to337 hits. Candidate occurrences and UID-level headers are discovery records, not relevance-confirmed studies.
Plant-specific atlas portals used; human/cancer resources and human/mouse Census not treated as Arabidopsis coverage.
No exact56.5 kPa/34%O2 Arabidopsis omics or low-pressure-treated single-cell/nucleus experiment verified within searched coverage.

No direct low-pressure epigenomics, proteomics or sample-matched pressure transcriptome/metabolome established within coverage; independent hypobaria metabolite deposit is not a paired multiomics cohort.
